g.text: Fewer hydrogen clashes, with residual contacts still visible

g.text: 127 paired structures per route · independent, unmodified legacy Probe · no hydrogen regeneration

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48596d

g.text: Below the diagonal = fewer flagged pairs. Nuclear radii and standard residue bonding; unique unordered pairs.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48596d

g.text: These are contact diagnostics, not experimental structural accuracy. Fixed-heavy clashes and some H contacts remain.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48596d

g.text: The candidate is retained for review only. Main, dev and their default images remain unchanged.
